# Shahan Ali (PROBOY, ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, proboy315)

> Shahan Ali (PROBOY) is a full-stack developer, AI and WhatsApp bot architect, and Shopify specialist based in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He builds React web applications, maintains the open-source ProBoy-MD WhatsApp multi-device bot, custom Shopify Online Store 2.0 storefronts, and Google Gemini integrations. He also writes source-checked engineering articles and maintains a documentation centre for his own project.

## Identity disambiguation
This Shahan Ali is the developer who works under the brand PROBOY from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan, and who owns the public ProBoy-MD repository and the PROBOY portfolio. Several people share the name; this file describes only the PROBOY developer and makes no claim about anyone else. The verifiable markers are the GitHub account proboy315, the ProBoy-MD repository, and the portfolio at proboy.vercel.app.

## Recognition
Certificate of Recognition for the Google Gemini QuizOff 2026, organised by CampusCrew and hosted on Unstop, awarded to Shahan (Shahan Ali) on 19 July 2026. This is a participation certificate of recognition, not an employment, partnership, endorsement or award from Google.

## Real projects
- [ProBoy-MD](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-md): Open-source Node.js WhatsApp multi-device bot using the Baileys library. At the audited commit (c05d3225, checked 2026-11-07) the repository contains 224 JavaScript command files across eight physical command directories: ai 49, dev 28, fun 43, general 26, group 30, media 12, textmaker 19, utility 17. Command metadata is explicit in source and permissions are enforced in the handler. Source: https://github.com/proboy315/ProBoy-MD
- [ProBoy CamLink](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-camlink): Camera shortlink and browser diagnostic utility with device telemetry logs and session management.
- [ProBoy JS Obfuscator](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-js-obfuscator): Client-side JavaScript obfuscation utility for transforming browser-delivered source code.
- [ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-encrypt-decrypt): Browser-native AES-256-GCM encryption suite with image steganography and a local history vault.
- [ProBoy-SiM_Database](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-sim-database): Structured lookup interface for browsing simulation records and cellular activation datasets.

## Counting notes
Command counts above describe the audited commit only. An earlier snapshot of the project recorded nine logical command categories and 537 unique invocable tokens; those numbers describe a different snapshot and are not reconciled with the audited commit. The repository's declared start script also references an entry file that is absent at the audited commit, so a working one-command start has not been verified.
